svg.aria-label: The events of one call of plastic intent end, from the top down. The call opens the kernel, which opens the databases and the routine run. Then Find the intent, Check the write lock and Check the ending run in turn; each gate that fails stops the call in the right column with exit 1 or exit 3. Check the ending ends on written or missing. On written, Close the intent closes the intent, drops the lock and writes the day ledger line, and the call finishes. On missing, the agent writes the outcome, and the call hands off.
svg.text: Kernel, writes the Work Graph and the Knowledge Graph
